tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels and everything that floats: the topbar, the filters panel, the place panel, search results, map popups, info bubbles, the dialog, the selected segment. The on-map legend is this at 92% (color-mix) over the map.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: The page ground behind the three-column grid (html, body). A step below surface-1 in both themes, so the panels sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: inputs, fact tiles, gap notes, the segmented track, neutral chips, and the hover and selected fill of every row, option and result.

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Names, values, headings and the selected label, on surface-1, surface-2 and surface-sunken (15.7:1 or more in both themes). Also the map's hover and selection outline.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Running text in panels and the dialog, unselected option names, list rows, legend labels and percentages, on any surface (6.9:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, notes, meta lines, counts, the legend ends and the group search placeholder; the app also sets its filter eyebrows in it, though they name each control (see Exceptions). Same value in both themes. Fails 4.5:1 in light on every surface (3.5:1 on surface-1, 3.4:1 on surface-2, 3.1:1 on surface-sunken) and on surface-sunken in dark (4.4:1), at 10.5px to 12px sizes: kept exact from the source. Use ink-secondary for anything a reader must be able to read.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px rules (topbar, panel heads, table rows) and the border of inputs, chips, lists, popups, bubbles and the dialog. It separates; it is not meant to contrast (about 1.2:1 on the surfaces).

tokens.name: axis
tokens.usage: The ring of the “i” info button at rest (1.5:1 on surface-1 in dark, 1.75:1 in light); hover and open turn it accent.

tokens.name: border-ring
tokens.usage: The translucent edge that keeps a colour key visible on any ground: legend swatches and scale, composition swatches, status chips, fact tiles, gap notes, the on-map legend card, the group dot.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive hue: focus outlines (2px), the selected option's border and name, links, breadcrumb buttons, the key filter chip and group chips, checkbox accent-color. As text it is below 4.5:1 at the small sizes it is used at (light: 4.3:1 on surface-1, 3.8:1 on surface-sunken; dark: 4.3:1 on surface-sunken) — kept from the source, flagged. As an outline or border it clears 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill: the key filter chip (.fchip-key, .68rem 600), the group chip in search results (.r-group, .65rem regular) and the skip link (1rem). 4.4:1 on accent in light and 3.6:1 in dark — below 4.5:1 for the two chips, kept from the source, flagged.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Recorded: a value with a named source and reference year. Fills the About key's chip-present and the coverage map's recorded units. Never alone: always the ● glyph and the word “Recorded”, except the About key, whose chip says “Present” and has no glyph (see Exceptions). Not a text colour.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Not yet available: the figure exists somewhere and this build has not fetched it. With the ▲ glyph and the words. Not a text colour (1.8:1 on surface-1).

tokens.name: status-serious
tokens.usage: Not collected: the country does not gather this at all. With the ◼ glyph and the words. Also the text and border of the partial-basis chip (“describes 10.6% of the population”), which sits on surface-sunken: 2.3:1 there in light — fails, kept from the source; 6.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Declared in app.css and used nowhere in the app. Reserved for an error state; do not spend it on data.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: The sea, and the map canvas behind every layer (MapLibre background and the #map element). Map.js reads it from CSS at style time.

tokens.name: land-base
tokens.usage: Land with nothing drawn on it, and the ground under countries whose second level does not tile them (“partial-land”): land with nothing known about it, never sea.

tokens.name: boundary
tokens.usage: Administrative boundary lines on the map. Read from CSS by map.js; widths and opacity per level are in the map section.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind an open dialog (dialog::backdrop). Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: group-any
tokens.usage: Grey that stands for “any group” in a legend: the base of the “Share of the leading group” ramp (Palette.groupRamp("#6b6b6b", 5)), and the ground of the hatched estimate key (.legend-swatch-hatched).

tokens.name: hatch-dark
tokens.usage: Dark stroke of the hatched estimate key in the legend (135deg: 1.6px dark, .7px light, .7px dark, 3px clear, every 6px). Stale: since 21 September 2026 the map draws an estimate exactly like a reading, so this key no longer matches anything on the map. Do not hatch estimates in new work.

tokens.name: hatch-light
tokens.usage: Light stroke that edges hatch-dark so the hatched estimate key reads on any fill. Stale with it: see hatch-dark.

tokens.name: categorical-1
tokens.usage: Composition slot 1: the largest row of a stacked bar and its list. Fixed order, never cycled, and only where every mark also carries a text label and a percentage (the composition bar and its list). A composition with more than eight rows shows seven and folds the rest into "Other groups (n)" in slot 8.

tokens.name: categorical-2
tokens.usage: Composition slot 2: the second row of a stacked bar and its list. Rules as categorical-1.

tokens.name: categorical-3
tokens.usage: Composition slot 3: the third row of a stacked bar and its list. Rules as categorical-1.

tokens.name: categorical-4
tokens.usage: Composition slot 4: the fourth row of a stacked bar and its list. Rules as categorical-1.

tokens.name: categorical-5
tokens.usage: Composition slot 5: the fifth row of a stacked bar and its list. Rules as categorical-1.

tokens.name: categorical-6
tokens.usage: Composition slot 6: the sixth row of a stacked bar and its list. Rules as categorical-1.

tokens.name: categorical-7
tokens.usage: Composition slot 7: the seventh row of a stacked bar and its list. Rules as categorical-1.

tokens.name: categorical-8
tokens.usage: Composition slot 8: the eighth row of a stacked bar and its list. Rules as categorical-1.

tokens.name: sequential-0
tokens.usage: Magnitude ramp step t=0.0 (palest = least). Computed by palette.js from hue #3987e5 at a relative-luminance target that runs pale to dark in both themes (light 0.78 to 0.055, dark 0.70 to 0.115): darker always means more. Every numeric choropleth: population, median age, how concentrated. The pale end is not the surface: small is not missing.

tokens.name: sequential-1
tokens.usage: Magnitude ramp step t=0.1 (palest = least). See sequential-0.

tokens.name: sequential-2
tokens.usage: Magnitude ramp step t=0.2 (palest = least). See sequential-0.

tokens.name: sequential-9

tokens.name: sequential-10
tokens.usage: Magnitude ramp step t=1.0 (palest = least). See sequential-0.

tokens.name: status-present
tokens.usage: Palette.STATUS.present (● “Recorded”): the map and legend fill for a recorded value. Alias of status-good, which the CSS uses for the same state.

tokens.name: status-not-available
tokens.usage: Palette.STATUS.not_available (▲ “Not yet available”). Alias of status-warning.

tokens.name: status-not-collected
tokens.usage: Palette.STATUS.not_collected (◼ “Not collected”). Alias of status-serious.

tokens.name: status-not-applicable
tokens.usage: Palette.STATUS.not_applicable (– “Not applicable”): the question does not apply to this unit. Same value as ink-muted but a data state, not a text colour.

tokens.name: status-derived
tokens.usage: Palette.STATUS.derived (◐ “Derived from published figures”): a figure computed from published ones. Fills derived units on the Data coverage view and colours the panel's badge. Neither a family colour nor the neutral, so “somebody computed” never reads as “nobody counted”. As badge text it is 3.2:1 on surface-1 in light, below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-modelled
tokens.usage: Palette.STATUS.modelled (◌ “Estimated, not published”): a modelled estimate. Fills modelled units on the Data coverage view and colours the panel's estimate badge. Elsewhere on the map an estimate is drawn exactly like a reading; the caveat lives in the panel. As badge text it is 3.6:1 on surface-1 in light, below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: leading-share-0
tokens.usage: Step 0 of the legend's “Share of the leading group” ramp, 25% or less. Palette.groupRamp("#6b6b6b", 5) on the default 25% to 100% range: a grey that stands for every group's hue at once, darker where the leading share is larger. With Fit to view on, the app recomputes it over the range on screen and gets the same five greys; only the end labels change (19% and 100%, for example).

tokens.name: leading-share-1
tokens.usage: Step 1 of the legend's “Share of the leading group” ramp, 44%. See leading-share-0.

tokens.name: leading-share-2
tokens.usage: Step 2 of the legend's “Share of the leading group” ramp, 63%. See leading-share-0.

tokens.name: leading-share-3
tokens.usage: Step 3 of the legend's “Share of the leading group” ramp, 81%. See leading-share-0.

tokens.name: leading-share-4
tokens.usage: Step 4 of the legend's “Share of the leading group” ramp, 100%. See leading-share-0.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: No figure: the map's fill where a unit has no value for the view, the legend's “No value / No figure” swatch, and what a ninth categorical slot falls back to (a visible bug, never a fabricated identity). It must recede: it means nobody counted.

tokens.name: unplaced
tokens.usage: A group the classification has not placed in its tree yet. A colour, not the neutral, because the unit has a figure; a violet-grey outside every family palette so it cannot be read as one.

tokens.name: religion-abrahamic
tokens.usage: Religion band (tier 1): Abrahamic religions. One base hue per tier-1 node, hand-picked from the Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe set where it stretches, the widest-reaching bands furthest apart (scripts/group_tree.py TIER_HUE). Families inside a band without a conventional colour take this hue turned by their place among their siblings (0, +30, -30, +15, -15 ... Degrees) at a varied saturation; anything deeper takes its family's. Painted flat only as the group picker's dot; the map and legend draw it through the luminance band, darker where the share is larger (Palette.group). Hue is never the only channel: every unit names its group on hover.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Headings are the browser bold (700) on h2/h3/strong; only letter-spacing and size are set. Line height is normal unless given.

styles.name: text-place-name
styles.usage: The selected place's name, top of the place panel (.entity-name, h2). The largest text in the app.

styles.name: text-dialog-title
styles.usage: The dialog's title (.dialog-head h2).

styles.name: text-empty-title
styles.usage: The empty place panel's heading (.empty-state h2).

styles.name: text-wordmark
styles.usage: The app name in the topbar (.brand-text strong), over the subline (text-count).

styles.name: text-panel-heading
styles.usage: A side panel's own heading (.filters-head h2).

styles.name: text-section-title
styles.usage: A panel section in the place panel (.panel-head h3): one topic, one figure.

styles.name: text-dialog-heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside the dialog (dialog h3).

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: Values carry the weight; their labels and meta stay small and muted.

styles.name: text-fact-value
styles.usage: A fact tile's value (.fact-value).

styles.name: text-fact-gap
styles.usage: A fact tile that has no value: the status glyph and its words (.fact-value.is-gap, ink-muted).

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Running text is small and set for reading, line height 1.45-1.6.

styles.name: text-lede
styles.sample: Click any country, state or district on the map, or search above.
styles.usage: The empty state's explanation (.empty-state p), the longest text a first-time reader meets.

styles.name: text-dialog-body
styles.sample: Percentages here should be read within a country, never across a border.
styles.usage: Paragraphs and list items in the dialog (dialog p, dialog li), ink-secondary.

styles.name: text-search
styles.usage: The topbar search input (.search input); 1rem at phone width so iOS does not zoom.

styles.name: text-result
styles.usage: A search result row (.search-results li); the name inside it is 600.

styles.name: text-row
styles.usage: List rows in the place panel: composition rows, child divisions (.composition-list li, .children-list button); the map popup.

styles.name: text-gap-note
styles.sample: Not collected. France does not collect ethnicity.
styles.usage: A gap note's sentence (.gap-note), at line height 1.5.

styles.name: text-subtitle
styles.usage: The place's subtitle under its name (.entity-sub), at normal line height, and the empty panel's note (.empty-note), which keeps the lede's 1.55 line height from .empty-state p; both ink-muted.

styles.name: text-context
styles.usage: The context line of a search result (.r-context, ink-muted) and the map status line (.map-status, ink-secondary).

styles.name: text-legend
styles.usage: The legend body, data tables and info bubbles (#legend, .data-table, .info-bubble at 1.5).

styles.name: text-note
styles.sample: Named without published shares: other, unaffiliated.
styles.usage: Notes under a figure (.note) and the empty group list (.group-empty), at 1.5. The same size sets source lists and the estimate line at 1.45, the table toggle at normal line height, and the popup meta line at MapLibre's inherited 20px.

groups.name: Controls
groups.note: A choice is its name on one line and the sentence that says what it does under it. An option row shows the sentence when chosen, hovered or focused; a check row always shows it.

styles.name: text-option
styles.usage: The name of an option row or check row (.opt-name, .check-name).

styles.name: text-control
styles.usage: Ghost buttons and the group search input (.ghost-button, .group-search input).

styles.name: text-group-name
styles.usage: A group's name in the group picker (.g-name).

styles.name: text-segment
styles.usage: A segmented button (.seg); 600 when checked.

styles.name: text-hint
styles.sample: One colour per group, darker where its share is larger.
styles.usage: The sentence under an option or check (.opt-hint, .check-hint), ink-muted.

styles.name: text-control-note
styles.usage: A note under a control (.control-note): counts, what the filter covers.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Uppercase through CSS: components/bundle.css adds text-transform to these five classes. Type the words in sentence case; the samples show how they render. Tracking is set per label (.04em to .06em), not by size; the smallest, the level chip at .65rem, tracks .04em.

styles.name: text-eyebrow
styles.usage: Filter section headings (.filter-section > h3), ink-muted, uppercase.

styles.name: text-breadcrumb
styles.usage: The place breadcrumb and level (.entity-breadcrumb), uppercase; parent names are accent buttons.

styles.name: text-fact-label
styles.usage: A fact tile's label (.fact-label), uppercase.

styles.name: text-table-head
styles.usage: Data table headers (.data-table th), uppercase. The total row takes the same treatment at .7rem (.data-table .total-row th).

styles.name: text-level-chip
styles.usage: The level chip on a search result (.r-level), uppercase.

groups.name: Meta
groups.note: Counts and percentages use tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric) so columns align.

styles.name: text-chip
styles.usage: Filter summary chips (.fchip); the key chip is 600 on accent.

styles.name: text-meta
styles.usage: Reference years, legend ends and reach-label details (.panel-year, .legend-ends, .reach-labels). The map attribution is .68rem too but set in MapLibre's own font.

styles.name: text-count
styles.usage: Counts beside child divisions (.children-list .c-count, tabular-nums), the brand subline (.brand-sub) and a group divider's name (.group-divider strong).

styles.name: text-reach
styles.usage: A group's reach and legend counts (.g-reach, .legend-group-count, .legend-shade-label); “more” lines are italic.

styles.name: text-fine
styles.usage: The smallest running text: fact meta, divider explanations (.fact-meta, .group-divider span at 1.45).

styles.name: text-aside
styles.usage: Italic asides: a group's parent and the source labels folded into it (.g-parent, .g-labels).

styles.name: text-basis-chip
styles.usage: The basis chip that says what share of the population a composition describes (.chip-basis).

styles.name: text-fitted
styles.sample: Fitted to the range on screen.
styles.usage: The “fitted” badge and note beside a stretched shading scale (.legend-fitted, .legend-fitted-note). The one px size in the app.

groups.name: Glyphs
groups.note: Unicode and emoji glyphs set as text, never icon fonts or image files.

styles.name: text-brand-mark
styles.usage: The 🗺️ map emoji before the wordmark (.brand-mark).

styles.name: text-twist
styles.usage: The group tree's twist (.g-twist): ▸ closed, ▾ open, in ink-muted.

styles.name: text-info
styles.usage: The “i” of an info button, relative to the heading it sits in (.info): italic bold in a 1.05em circle.

spacing.note: The app has no spacing scale: paddings are hand-set in rem per component (see components/bundle.css). These are the layout roles the components share.

tokens.name: gutter-panel
tokens.usage: Inline padding of the filters panel and the topbar.

tokens.name: gutter-sidebar
tokens.usage: Inline padding of the place panel body (1rem above, 3rem below).

tokens.name: gutter-dialog
tokens.usage: Inline padding of the dialog article (1rem above, 1.6rem below).

tokens.name: topbar-gap
tokens.usage: Between the brand, the search box and the actions in the topbar (.5rem at phone width).

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Space above each filter section.

tokens.name: panel-gap
tokens.usage: Space below each section of the place panel.

tokens.name: tile-gap
tokens.usage: Between fact tiles in their two-column grid.

tokens.name: overlay-inset
tokens.usage: How far the on-map legend and the map status sit from the map's edges. Where the legend rises above the scale bar and the attribution, it is also the gap between them.

radius.note: Two named radii in the source (radius, radius-sm); the rest are literals there, named here. Soft rectangles; pills only for chips and the status line.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Large frames: the search box and its results, the on-map legend, the dialog, the bottom sheet's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls and tiles: ghost buttons, option and check rows, the segmented track, inputs, fact tiles, gap notes, popups, info bubbles, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inside a control: segmented buttons, group rows, the composition bar's outer ends.

tokens.name: radius-swatch
tokens.usage: Colour keys: legend swatches and scale, composition swatches, status chips, the tree twist.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: The group picker's colour dot.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: filter chips, search level chips, basis chips, the fitted badge, the map status line.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The info button's circle.

shadow.note: One elevation for everything that floats; borders do the rest.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Anything over the map or the page: search results, the on-map legend, the map status, popups, info bubbles, the dialog, and the filters drawer and place sheet below 900px.

tokens.name: shadow-seg
tokens.usage: Lifts the checked button out of a segmented track.

tokens.name: shadow-swatch-provisional
tokens.usage: Outline of a group dot whose colour has not been set yet (.g-swatch-none), so it reads as provisional.

size.note: Layout measures. The three column sizes keep their app names.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: The place panel column, right.

tokens.name: filters-w
tokens.usage: The filters column, left, when open (zero-width when closed, so the map can follow the resize).

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Topbar height until it is measured. The app measures the topbar with a ResizeObserver and writes the real height here whenever it changes (54px on desktop, 63px from 641px to about 767px where the labels wrap, 55px on a phone). The filters drawer starts below it.

tokens.name: search-w
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the topbar search.

tokens.name: results-h
tokens.usage: Maximum height of the search results (and never over 60vh).

tokens.name: group-list-h
tokens.usage: Maximum height of the group picker list (and never over 46vh; 50vh on phones).

tokens.name: children-h
tokens.usage: Maximum height of the child-divisions list before it scrolls.

tokens.name: legend-w
tokens.usage: Width of the on-map legend card on desktop; full width less the insets below 900px.

tokens.name: dialog-w
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the dialog.

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: Filters drawer width below 900px (and never over 90vw).

tokens.name: sheet-h
tokens.usage: Place sheet height below 900px (and never over 62vh).

tokens.name: bubble-w
tokens.usage: Maximum width of an info bubble (and never wider than the viewport less 1rem).

tokens.name: z-sticky-head
tokens.usage: The filters panel heading, sticky inside its own scroll.

tokens.name: z-map-legend
tokens.usage: The on-map legend.

tokens.name: z-map-status
tokens.usage: The map status line.

tokens.name: z-sidebar
tokens.usage: The place panel.

tokens.name: z-filters
tokens.usage: The filters panel.

tokens.name: z-topbar
tokens.usage: The topbar.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: The filters panel as a drawer below 900px.

tokens.name: z-search-results
tokens.usage: Search results.

tokens.name: z-info-bubble
tokens.usage: Info bubbles, above everything but the skip link.

tokens.name: z-skip-link
tokens.usage: Skip links when focused.
